missingMember: Add an email, or a first and last name, to match a member.
invalidBirthDate: Use a date of birth like 2010-05-31.
recordKind: Add either a rank with its promotion date, or an attendance date.
bothKinds: A row holds either a promotion or an attendance, not both.
invalidDate: Use a date like 2024-03-01, or a date and time like 2024-03-01T18:30, optionally with a UTC offset.
futureDate: This date is in the future.
duplicateRow: Same as row {row} in this file.
ambiguousMember: Several members match this row. Add an email, both names, or a date of birth to tell them apart.
noRankSystem: This program has no rank system.
unknownRank: No rank with this name exists in the program's rank system.
ambiguousRank: Several ranks in the program's rank system have this name.
invalidSubRank: Use a sub-rank number from 0 to {max}, or the name of one of this rank's sub-ranks.
historyConflict: This promotion conflicts with the member's promotion history in this program.
